data.long_meaning: Dharmil is a unisex name that comes from Sanskrit. It means 'God's devotee'. The name Dharmil carries the meaning “God's devotee” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dharmil usually hope their child will grow to embody god's devotee and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Dharmil is deeply rooted in the Hindu belief system.
